QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_28

question.text: All changes in terms of the PPM and in the documents of an AIF shall be intimated to its investors and SEBI on a CONSOLIDATED basis, within what period?

answer.text: Within 10 calendar days of each change.
Within 30 days of each change individually.
Within 1 month of the end of each financial year, consolidated.
Within 180 days of the end of each financial year.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 12: 'all AIFs are required to intimate SEBI and investors about any changes in terms of PPM and other fund documents. These changes are to be reported on a CONSOLIDATED manner within 1 MONTH of the end of each financial year.' The intimation must specifically mention the changes with relevant revised pages. **The Trap:** T+10 is quarterly activity reporting. 30 days per individual change ignores 'consolidated' requirement. 180 days is the annual LP investor report window. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C covers this identically. Do not confuse consolidated PPM intimation (1 month post-FY) with the quarterly SEBI filing (T+10). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Maintain a running 'PPM change log' throughout the year. Come April, you consolidate and file in one shot. Piecemeal filings invite SEBI queries and signal sloppy compliance governance.
